title: Pet Sublimit Allowance — Listings Pet Fee Bands by HostCover Pet-Damage Sublimit
content:
# Pet Sublimit Allowance

*Band table for Roamhaven Listings, read against the listing's Host Damage Protection (HostCover) plan.*

On top of the standard pet-fee ceiling, a listing may carry a pet sublimit allowance, worked out on the day of the pet-fee reset. It reads the pet-damage sublimit — the most paid on one pet-damage claim — of the HostCover level that the listing's active Host Damage Protection (HostCover) plan holds. The allowance is added to the listing's pet-fee ceiling.

| Pet-damage sublimit of the HostCover level on the listing's active plan | Pet sublimit allowance |
|---|---|
| at most $1000.00 | $25.00 |
| above $1000.00 and at most $2500.00 | $10.00 |
| above $2500.00 | none |

## Band edges (hypothetical sublimits)

| Sublimit | Band | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| $750.00 | at most $1000.00 | $25.00 |
| $1000.00 | at most $1000.00 — the edge belongs to the lower band | $25.00 |
| $1000.01 | above $1000.00 and at most $2500.00 | $10.00 |
| $2500.00 | at most $2500.00 — the edge belongs to the middle band | $10.00 |
| $5000.00 | above $2500.00 | none |

The sublimit read is the one of the HostCover level the listing's **active** plan holds.
